title: Etaleness of inertia invariants for finite group actions on arbitrary rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must show the invariant-ring map is etale at a selected prime without normality or finite-type assumptions. Etale localization splits the integral fibre, and a further equivariant clopen refinement makes the group permute factors; the inertia subgroup then identifies a factor of the full invariant ring.
